summary: Virginia Department of Forestry 125-foot steel tower in Amelia County, built 1965 and dismantled in 2004-05; the register photo shows its footings.

facts.status_note: Dismantled in 2004-05; the register shows the footings.

events.note: Build year in the register; 1965 survey description matches the height
Removed circa 2004-2005 (register); dismantled 2004-05 (Forest Lookouts). The record says 2005.

evidence.supports: Administered by the Virginia Department of Forestry
Design: 125-foot Aermotor steel tower, painted gray
evidence.quote: This 125-foot Aermotor steel tower was painted grey.
It was built in 1965 and removed circa 2004-2005.

evidence.supports: Photo labeled as the tower footings, credited to Google

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives circa 2004-2005 and the Forest Lookouts page gives 2004-05. The record's 2005 is the end of that range, so no correction is proposed.

notes_for_editor: The 1965 survey station one mile southwest of Amelia gives the same 125-foot height and four-legged steel frame as the register, so the story treats it as probably the same tower; this is an inference, not a stated link. The survey page's road directions are not repeated because they may be out of date. No source read gives staffing, use history or current access. The register's footings photo is a caption only; its date and licence are unknown, so no photo is listed. Amelia's Denaro tower (also in Amelia County, on the Association list) is a different site and was not used. The brief's 'Virginia Department of Forestry' agency matches the register.
